== Research Notes ==
=== Parish household review, 23 October 2026 ===

[[Glasgow-1333|Andrew Glasgow]] → [[Glasgow-81|John Glasgow]]: 60% → 98% (confident). Andrew’s 11 January 1747 West Calder baptism explicitly names John Glasgow and Magdalen Guthrie. The exact baptism boundary and complete parental couple match the household represented by John-81 and the maintained Jean 1745/Magdalen 1749 sequence. John’s otherwise sparse biography is no longer a reason to describe Andrew’s parent fields as missing. 98% concerns the recorded 1747 child and the John/Magdalen adult household. It establishes neither John’s own childhood nor any later merchant, miller or Leith identity for Andrew. Betty-82’s father remains 37%: the new 1765 Cambusnethan Betty record instead names James Glasgow and Anne Prentice, and has no proved Nichol-adult bridge. Companion indexes represent one event; original register image uninspected.

Earlier dated percentages and interpretations below are retained as superseded history for these pairs; the current assessments and their specific identity limits are stated here. No live WikiTree changes have been made by this local review.

The existing father [[Glasgow-1546]] is assessed at 39% (possible). The inherited John of 1709 fits between the older Andrew household’s 1702 James and 1714 Andrew children at Kirknewton. That offers a specific local family and compatible generation. John’s own profile explicitly lacks a source, so the interval and family slot cannot establish him as another son.
